sentences.text: Fahrenheit 451 is a 1966 British Dystopian science fiction drama film directed by François Truffaut and starring Oskar Werner , Julie Christie , and Cyril Cusack .	François Truffaut	François Truffaut	Fahrenheit 451	Fahrenheit 451	Oskar Werner	Oskar Werner	Julie Christie	Julie Christie	Cyril Cusack	Cyril Cusack	Dystopian	Dystopian	science fiction	science fiction

Based on the 1953 novel of the same name by Ray Bradbury , the film takes place in a controlled society in an oppressive future in which a fireman , whose duty it is to burn all literature , becomes a fugitive for reading .	Ray Bradbury	Ray Bradbury	novel of the same name	Fahrenheit 451
This was Truffaut 's first colour film as well as his only English-language film .
At the 1966 Venice Film Festival , Fahrenheit 451 was nominated for the Golden Lion .	Fahrenheit 451	Fahrenheit 451	Venice Film Festival	Venice Film Festival	Golden Lion	Golden Lion
